topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger names the English LRW benchmark or the Mandarin LRW-1000 / CAS-VSR-W1K benchmark (word-level lip reading), classified by the visual front end their full text names: spatiotemporal (3D) convolution, ResNet trunk, VGG trunk, ViT or patch transformer. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); audio-visual studies stay in; versions count once by key (the target has three keys); dated by first public month (prior before 2016-09, [concurrent] 2016-09 to 2017-09, [later] after).
